recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future work should address only specific, newly identified financial documentation or example gaps with targeted Jira issues, not as a broad reopening of FHIR-11404.
issue_request: Published/Not Persuasive FM change request from the DSTU2 cycle asking for more explanatory documentation and examples for financial resources so implementers new to financial transactions could understand resource purpose and use. The Jira resolution said to add materials as resources allowed and consider future STU R4 work; the reporter later commented that R4 publication materials satisfied the concern.
initial_application: No local git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-11404 was found. The relevant application appears to have happened through broader financial documentation work before R4, especially c3f620a7e9370a2501bafe6458fa2eab39169d2b and d0e148e3999aa370957861e92bb662a36cd5b806, which added shared financial-module explanatory sections and Claim links to them.
additional_context: The Financial module page is in the source hierarchy and the relevant financial resources are active in source/fhir.ini. Current source includes overview, glossary, common use cases, task flows, lifecycle, secondary-use, attachments, subrogation, coordination-of-benefit, batching, real-time exchange, 3-tier hierarchy, tax, roadmap, and terminology sections. Active financial resources also have example lists across the domain. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later final decision requiring a new broad financial-module documentation change.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The issue was closed as Not Persuasive/Published after the reporter confirmed R4 materials satisfied the concern, and current source already contains the broad explanatory documentation and examples requested. Adding untargeted prose now would duplicate existing material rather than fix a current spec defect.
